title: Top Drug Kingpin Is Captured by Mexican Army as Gunfire Erupts
summary_full: The arrest of Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, who is known as El Chapo Isidro and was one of the F.B.I.’s 10 most wanted, was a victory for the Mexican government.
